$16\div8+4\times2=1$
parts.solution_md:
> *To make 1, 16 needs to be divided by 16.*

> $8+4\times2=16$* (because we perform the multiplication before the addition):*

$8+4\times2=8+8=16$

> * So the brackets need to go around *$8+4\times2$*.*

> * *

$16\div(8+4\times2)=1$* ***[1]**
